$comment: CLM-0628 · RISK-0068 — files whose runtime code touches the file system or names a path outside its package.

Read by scripts/deploy/render_plan.py (declared reads become deploy inputs of every service whose closure contains the file) and audited by scripts/deploy/runtime_reads.py via scripts/checks/validate-render-deploy-plan.sh.

`fs` is the measured fingerprint (imported fs names → call count); any change fails the check until the reads are re-reviewed. Policy: runtime-input equivalence, not image-byte equivalence (the image is COPY . .).
